build_atomic_graph_attention_data: build a GraphAttentionData object from AtomicData by preprocessing molecular graphs with radius graph, edge expansion, and spherical harmonics
create_edge_distance_expansion: create edge distance expansion features using Gaussian, sigmoid, linear sigmoid, or SiLU smearing functions on edge distances
compute_frequency_vectors: compute frequency vectors for neighbor attention by calculating spherical harmonics on edge directions with configurable repeat patterns
calculate_bond_orientational_order: calculate Bond-Orientational Order (BOO) for each node using spherical harmonics on neighbor direction vectors with masking
generate_node_attention_mask: generate node attention masks including base mask and sincx rotary encoding for all-to-all node attention in molecular graphs
